template: Relocation assistance for illegal-occupancy evictions applies to this address. Source: N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.1(g); N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.1(h); N.J.A.C. 5:11-8.5(c); as of 2026-10-01. Not legal advice.
